# Khula Business Solutions
> Durban-based, 100% female-owned people-transformation consultancy. Tailored corporate training, NLP-based coaching, change management, project management and behaviour transformation for government, parastatal and corporate clients across South Africa.

Contact: +27 83 570 1564 · thilo@khulabs.co.za

## Services
- [Pre- & Post-Intervention Diagnostic](https://khulabusinesssolutions.co.za/services/pre-post-intervention-diagnostic/): Benchmark before and after every intervention so impact is measured, not assumed.
- [NLP-Based Executive, Business & Life Coaching](https://khulabusinesssolutions.co.za/services/nlp-executive-coaching/): Targeted coaching for leadership, resilience and high performance, grounded in NLP.
- [Tailored Training Solutions](https://khulabusinesssolutions.co.za/services/tailored-training-solutions/): Learning experiences designed and delivered around your strategy and goals.
- [Mindset & Behaviour Transformation](https://khulabusinesssolutions.co.za/services/mindset-behaviour-transformation/): Shift mindset, behaviour, habits and culture to unlock sustainable performance.
- [Change Management](https://khulabusinesssolutions.co.za/services/change-management/): Structured support to help teams navigate transition and embed lasting change.
- [Project Management](https://khulabusinesssolutions.co.za/services/project-management/): End-to-end planning, execution and oversight for impactful delivery.
- [Business & Computer Skills Training](https://khulabusinesssolutions.co.za/services/business-computer-skills-training/): Practical skills development to boost operational efficiency and digital fluency.
- [Train the Trainer](https://khulabusinesssolutions.co.za/services/train-the-trainer/): Equip internal trainers with the skills and confidence to sustain learning.
